meta.title: A Breath of Air
meta.x_note: `meta` is the plan §3.5 shape. compileStoryboard() actually reads `title`/`aspect`/`total_duration_ms` at the TOP level and `start_ms`/`end_ms` per scene. The two shapes do not agree; reconciling them is R1's first job. See NOTES.md §4.

tokens.x_note: Resolved from Design.md. The current emitter ignores this section entirely (the plan says so); it is carried so R1 can wire it.

frame.x_note: Resolved from Frame.md. Also ignored by the current emitter. The ramp is a single size per role; the film's titles actually take four (104/96/82/78), which the RAMP SHAPE ITSELF cannot express — see NOTES.md §6.

background.x_note: The emitter has ONE flat `sb.background` for the whole reel. Every scene here has its own gradient; four backgrounds cannot be expressed at all. See NOTES.md §1.

ambient.x_note: Decorative, infinite, easing ease-in-out. The emitter has no ambient concept and no `ease-in-out`. See NOTES.md §1 and §7.
`direction: reverse` is authored here. The WAAPI adapter parses it into the spec and then never reads it, so the rendered film does NOT reverse. See NOTES.md §7.
